cards.ex: He's not one to rock the boat, so he'll probably just agree with whatever the boss says.
cards.exUz: U tinchlikni buzadigan odam emas, shuning uchun u xo'jayin nima desa ham rozi bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tinchlikni buzadigan, muammoga sabab bo'ladigan ish qilmoq.

cards.ex: The system of checks and balances prevents any one branch of government from becoming too powerful.
cards.exUz: Tiyib turish tizimi hukumatning biror tarmog'i haddan tashqari kuchayib ketishining oldini oladi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumatning bir tarmog'i boshqasining kuchini cheklaydigan tizim.

cards.ex: The bill was criticized for containing too much pork barrel spending.
cards.exUz: Qonun loyihasi juda ko'p keraksiz xarajatlarni o'z ichiga olgani uchun tanqid qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Siyosatchilar o'z okruglariga foyda keltiradigan keraksiz xarajatlar.

cards.ex: Politicians often make empty promises during election campaigns.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchilar ko'pincha saylov kampaniyalari paytida bo'sh va'dalar berishadi.
cards.uzDef: Amalga oshirilmaydigan va'dalar.

cards.ex: Partisan politics is making it difficult to pass important legislation.
cards.exUz: Guruhbozlik siyosati muhim qonunlarni qabul qilishni qiyinlashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Siyosiy partiyalar o'rtasidagi adovat va kelishmovchiliklar.

cards.ex: We had to jump through so many hoops just to get the permit approved.
cards.exUz: Ruxsatnomani tasdiqlash uchun juda ko'p harakat qilishimizga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir erishish uchun qiyin yoki keraksiz ishlarni qilmoq.

cards.ex: The debate turned into a war of words between the two candidates.
cards.exUz: Munozara ikki nomzod o'rtasida og'zaki urushga aylanib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq bahs yoki mojarolar seriyasi.

cards.ex: The proposal to raise taxes will be on the ballot this November.
cards.exUz: Soliqlarni oshirish taklifi shu noyabr oyida byulletenda bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Saylov byulletenida nomzod yoki masala sifatida ro'yxatga olingan.

cards.ex: It's going to be an uphill battle to get this law passed.
cards.exUz: Bu qonunni qabul qilish juda qiyin kurash bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yengish qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: You'll have to get approval from the powers that be before you can proceed.
cards.exUz: Davom etishdan oldin yuqoridagilardan ruxsat olishingiz kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatdagi odamlar yoki tashkilotlar.

cards.ex: The issue of healthcare reform hits close to home for many families.
cards.exUz: Sog'liqni saqlash islohoti masalasi ko'p oilalar uchun shaxsiy ta'sirga ega.
cards.uzDef: Odamning hayotiga yoki qadriyatlariga bevosita ta'sir qiladi.

cards.ex: The campaign distributed talking points to all of its volunteers.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya o'zining barcha ko'ngillilariga asosiy fikrlarni tarqatdi.
cards.uzDef: Bahs yoki nutq paytida ishlatiladigan muhim fikrlar yoki dalillar.

cards.ex: The redistricting process can have a significant impact on election outcomes.
cards.exUz: Chegaralarni o'zgartirish saylov natijalariga sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Saylov okruglarining chegaralarini qayta chizish jarayoni.

cards.ex: Legalizing marijuana could be a slippery slope to legalizing other drugs.
cards.exUz: Marixuani qonuniylashtirish boshqa giyohvand moddalarni qonuniylashtirish uchun xavfli yo'l bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Bir harakat boshqa yomonroq harakatlarga olib kelishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: The lawsuit was seen as a shot across the bow to other companies in the industry.
cards.exUz: Sud da'vosi sohadagi boshqa kompaniyalar uchun ogohlantiruvchi zarba sifatida qaraldi.
cards.uzDef: Ogohlantiruvchi signal yoki harakat.

cards.ex: Political gridlock in Congress is preventing any progress on important issues.
cards.exUz: Kongressdagi siyosiy to'siq muhim masalalar bo'yicha hech qanday taraqqiyotga yo'l qo'ymayapti.
cards.uzDef: Siyosiy partiyalar o'rtasidagi kelishmovchilik tufayli qonunlarni qabul qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: These new findings call into question the government's official report.
cards.exUz: Bu yangi topilmalar hukumatning rasmiy hisobotini shubha ostiga qo'yadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir to'g'riligi yoki haqiqiyligiga shubha qilmoq.

cards.ex: The company used smoke and mirrors to hide its financial problems.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya moliyaviy muammolarini yashirish uchun aldamchi usullardan foydalangan.
cards.uzDef: Aldash yoki yashirish uchun ishlatiladigan usullar.

cards.ex: A watchdog group is monitoring the government's spending.
cards.exUz: Nazorat guruhi hukumatning xarajatlarini kuzatib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tashkilotlarning faoliyatini kuzatib boradigan guruh.

cards.ex: We need to hold politicians accountable for their promises.
cards.exUz: Biz siyosatchilarni o'z va'dalari uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir o'z harakatlari uchun javob berishga majbur qilmoq.

cards.ex: The negotiations are taking place behind closed doors.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar yopiq eshiklar ortida o'tkazilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ommaga oshkor qilinmaydigan tarzda.

cards.ex: He's been a major player in the political arena for many years.
cards.exUz: U ko'p yillar davomida siyosiy maydonda asosiy o'yinchi bo'lib kelgan.
cards.uzDef: Siyosiy faoliyat olib boriladigan joy.

cards.ex: The government is trying to push through legislation on healthcare reform.
cards.exUz: Hukumat sog'liqni saqlash islohoti bo'yicha qonun qabul qilishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qarshilikka qaramay, qonunni qabul qilishga erishmoq.

cards.ex: The dictator's death created a power vacuum in the country.
cards.exUz: Diktatorning o'limi mamlakatda hokimiyat bo'shlig'ini yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Rahbar yo'qligi sababli yuzaga kelgan beqarorlik holati.

cards.ex: The new government is widely seen as a puppet government controlled by the neighboring country.
cards.exUz: Yangi hukumat ko'pchilik tomonidan qo'shni davlat tomonidan boshqariladigan qo'g'irchoq hukumat sifatida ko'rilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa davlat tomonidan boshqariladigan hukumat.

cards.ex: The election campaign has turned into a mud-slinging campaign.
cards.exUz: Saylov kampaniyasi qoralash kampaniyasiga aylanib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Nomzodlarning bir-birini qoralaydigan kampaniyasi.

cards.ex: I voted for him, even though I didn't like him, because he was the lesser of two evils.
cards.exUz: Men unga ovoz berdim, garchi u menga yoqmasa ham, chunki u ikki yomondan yengili edi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki yomon tanlovdan eng yengilini tanlash.

cards.ex: Regulations are needed to ensure a fair playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Barcha bizneslar uchun adolatli kurash maydonini ta'minlash uchun qoidalar zarur.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy me'yorlar va imkoniyatlar nuqtai nazaridan teng sharoit.

cards.ex: The opposition party accused the government of using gerrymandering tactics to win the election.
cards.exUz: Muxolifat partiyasi hukumatni saylovda g'alaba qozonish uchun gerimandering taktikasidan foydalanishda aybladi.
cards.uzDef: Saylov okruglarini bir partiyaga foyda keltiradigan tarzda chizish.

cards.ex: The government is trying to win hearts and minds in the region by providing aid.
cards.exUz: Hukumat yordam berish orqali mintaqada odamlarning ko'nglini olishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarning qo'llab-quvvatlashini yoki roziligini qozonish.
